subject.title: [Feature]: Slack Block Kit support for agent messages

question: Should OpenClaw bless a Slack-native Block Kit producer path for trusted reports, or keep `presentation` as the only supported rich-output API and defer richer tables/rich_text to a portable schema design?
rationale: Current code can send raw blocks and render portable presentations, but choosing a documented provider-native report/table API would define a user-facing channel contract beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep this issue as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.

options.title: Bless provider-native Slack blocks
options.body: Document a trusted-producer Slack Block Kit path with required fallback text, validation limits, examples, and live Slack proof before implementation PRs proceed.

options.title: Portable presentation only
options.body: Document that raw Slack blocks remain internal/legacy and track metric fields, table layouts, and rich_text conversion as a future portable presentation schema.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the Slack-native producer boundary, then close it only after the chosen path is documented or split into a narrower live issue.
